page.overview:
Who is Faolain Orande?

Faolain Orande is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, sworn to Egwene al'Vere.

Faolain is dark of complexion and has a round face and dark curly hair.

Faolain is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power potential of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She has had a suffient length of training to assume she has already reached her full potential.
